definitions.gloss: bird's-eye view, looking down from above
definitions.explanation: The act of looking down at something from a high position, such as from a mountain or tall building.
Looking at a situation or issue from a detached, comprehensive viewpoint. Taking in the whole picture rather than focusing on details.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{俯瞰|ふかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Look down at the town from the mountain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{展望台|てんぼうだい}→展望台：18278_tenboudai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{俯瞰|ふかん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{美|うつく}しかった→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The view from above at the observation deck was beautiful.

examples.japanese: ⟦ドローン→ドローン：06097_doroon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{俯瞰|ふかん}⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Take aerial footage with a drone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{俯瞰|ふかん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧みる。
examples.english: Try looking at the problem from a broader perspective.

examples.japanese: {俯瞰|ふかん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{全体像|ぜんたいぞう}→全体像：16443_zentaizou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: When you look at it from a broader perspective, you can see the whole picture.

examples.english: It's important to have opportunities to take an overview of your own life.

notes:
{俯瞰|ふかん} has both a literal meaning (looking down physically from a high place) and a figurative meaning (taking a broad, detached perspective on a situation). The figurative use is increasingly common in business and media.

ETYMOLOGY:
{俯|ふ} (to look down) + {瞰|かん} (to look out over). Both kanji are rare outside this word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {俯瞰|ふかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to look down upon, to take an overview
- {俯瞰|ふかん}{的|てき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look at from a broad perspective
- {俯瞰|ふかん}{図|ず}: bird's-eye view map
- {俯瞰|ふかん}⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧: aerial photography

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {鳥瞰|ちょうかん}: bird's-eye view (synonym, literally "bird's gaze")
- {概観|がいかん}: overview, general survey (less visual nuance)
- ⟦{見渡|みわた}す→見渡す：07169_miwatasu⟧: to look out over, to survey (native Japanese verb)
